Hooks are the build's stable table-wrapper aria-labels and the article's own heading structure. No element is injected into the article body; no `display` property is changed on any table element, so table semantics are preserved. DEVIATION from voyage-article-visual-designer SKILL.md §5, which specifies Phase 2 as standalone SVG assets — approved by the Product Owner on 2026-07-18 in favour of visible results without a build change.
